rules.statement: The right of pre-emption is given to co-owners and those who will be the heirs of the vendor in the event of his dying intestate, without any order of precedence or preference among them.
rules.supporting_quote: "This interpretation is strengthened by the provisions of Section 13. Markandu v. Rajadurai (58 N. L. R. 394) not followed."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Thesawalamai Pre-emption Ordinance (Cap. 64, Revised Edition, 1956)
